about: Open-circuit voltage against state of charge per chemistry, per cell (performance/battery.py; spec: Power and efficiency analysis, 'Range, endurance and speed'). LiPo is a measured curve; the other chemistries take its shape between their own empty and full voltages ('shape' and 'full_v', 'empty_v'), an approximation marked as such and refined by each pack's own flights. cutoff_v is the lowest cell voltage under load the discharge simulation flies to: below it the pack is spent whatever the failsafes say. LiFePO4 is so flat in its middle that its charge cannot be read from voltage; its capacity is the rated one.

fit.about: A pack's capacity and resistance from one flight: its terminal voltage modelled as cells x OCV(z0 - charge used / Q) - R0 I - R1 (I low-passed with tau_s), z0 read from the voltage at rest before arming; R0 and R1 by least squares for each Q, Q searched within capacity_range of the rated capacity with a prior of capacity_spread. A flight that uses less than min_soc_span of the pack gives its resistance only. When the capacity found is at the search's edge, or the model misses the voltage by more than max_rms_cell_v a cell (RMS), the rated capacity is far from the pack's: the search is made again without the prior, from the least the pack can hold (the charge used over the charge it started with) to the most a flight using min_soc_span of it shows; a fit that still misses by more is not trusted. On a flight (analyzers/pack.py), each monitor that measures its own pack is fitted over its rows from arming to disarming, up to the first row below cells x the chemistry's cutoff_v (a pack run flat collapses there, which no curve follows); its rest is the median of the last rest_samples rows before arming, else the quietest row within rest_window_s of arming (ArduPilot logs nothing before arming unless LOG_DISARMED is set), corrected for its current by the fitted R0.

sources: LiPo open-circuit voltage against state of charge: ArduPilot's simulator battery table (libraries/SITL/SIM_Battery.cpp at Copter-4.7.0, soc_table), from a measured LiPo cell discharge.

Full and empty cell voltages by chemistry: ArduPilot wiki, Battery Monitors and the Initial Parameter Setup (LiPo 4.2 V full; LiHV 4.35 V; Li-ion about 4.2 to 2.5 V; LiFePO4 3.65 V full), and Mission Planner's ConfigInitialParams.cs cell values.

The equivalent-circuit model (open-circuit voltage, series resistance, one RC branch for the slow sag): Plett, Battery Management Systems, Volume I: Battery Modeling, Artech House, 2015, ch. 2; the same graybox form predicts multicopter pack voltage within about 1.3% (Bauersfeld and Scaramuzza, IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters 7(2), 2022).
